name: telmoni-plugins
description: Telmoni's plugin for Claude Code, installed from this repository. Telmoni is privacy-first, open-source monitoring for AI agents.

plugins.name: telmoni-observability
plugins.description: Records each turn of your Claude Code sessions in Telmoni as a trace: the models and their tokens, the tools, the subagents and the times, and the tags you set. The conversation itself, your prompts and images, the replies and their plain-text thinking, each tool's input and output, only once you turn on Capture content and the project keeps content. Telmoni is privacy-first, open-source monitoring for AI agents.
